name: subnet-calculator-sqa
description: Kalkulator Subnet IPv4 berbasis web dengan pengujian Software Quality Assurance (BVA & Equivalence Partitioning)

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.slice(1);let p=path.join(__dirname,f);if(fs.existsSync(p)&&fs.statSync(p).isFile()){let m={'html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','css':'text/css','js':'text/javascript','json':'application/json'}[path.extname(p).slice(1)]||'text/plain';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');}}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('Kalkulator Subnet berjalan di: http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Antigravity
